arguments.command:
cd /app/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
src=open('perf.py').read()
old = src[src.index("def make_borders"):src.index("def gen_stream_big")]
new = '''def make_borders(rnd, R, U):
    if R == 1:
        return [0, U]
    assert U >= R + 1, (U, R)
    cuts = sorted(rnd.sample(range(1, U), R - 1))
    borders = [0] + cuts + [U]
    assert borders[0] == 0 and borders[-1] == U and len(borders) == R + 1
    assert all(borders[i] < borders[i + 1] for i in range(R))
    return borders


'''
open('perf.py','w').write(src.replace(old,new))
